content:
**Slugger** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Melee weapons deal more damage to crippled enemies.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Your melee weapons do +30% damage to crippled targets. | 000E36FD | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your melee weapons do +20% damage to crippled targets. | 000E36FC | 
| ★ | 1 | Your melee weapons do +10% damage to crippled targets. | 0004A0B5 |
